note: Evening preset (#254 C19). Sun angles use Petalwake tools/terrain/bake.py conventions: azimuth from +z (south) toward +x (east). The terrain sun-shadow channel for this sun is baked by scripts/bake-evening-light.py into the local Petalwake checkout.

doorGlow.note: Art round 9b: fake lamp light pools (door-glow.js). Wall patch wallSize m (w,h) centred wallDrop under the lamp, stopping wallTop above it; floor patch radius floorRadius, centred floorOut off the wall; falloff = exponent of the radial ramp.

shopSpill.note: Art round 10: shop light spilling on the paving in front of the door (shop-spill.js). Patch = street front wide, depth m out, strongest at the wall; edge = side fade in m; falloff = exponent of the outward ramp; cell = grid spacing in m (one shared-vertex grid per front, each vertex laid at the paving height under it; triangles bridging a step are dropped); rayLift = m above the room floor where the ground rays start, so anything taller is not ground; wallOut = m outside the room's inner face. cool = convenience store / laundromat, warm = other shops.
